يعتذرون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَذِرُونَ (yaʕtaḏirūna) /jaʕ.ta.ði.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# يُعْتَذَرُونَ (yuʕtaḏarūna) /juʕ.ta.ða.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
